description: Retrieves relevant documents based on image embeddings using nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2 embedding model + nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2 reranker model.

nodes.description: Queries the document store and returns the top matching results.
Reranks the retrieved documents based on relevance to the query.

edges.description: Passes the retrieved documents to the reranker for further processing.
